caption: The drawing features a rectangular section in the center of a plain, off-white background. Within this central section, there is a pixelated or cross-stitch style depiction of a bird in profile, facing left. The bird has a long, narrow beak and stands on two legs. Its body is composed of black, blue, yellow, red, and white areas, with the wing and back in dark blue and black, the belly in yellow, and the head and upper wing in red and black. Surrounding the bird is a pattern of green vines and stems with red and pink flowers, as well as small diamond-shaped accents in yellow. A border, made of a repeated red wave-like design, frames the bird and floral motifs. The grid pattern resembles hand-drawn or embroidered needlework. The drawing is centered on the page with ample blank space around it.
title: Purse
